description: A replica overwrites a locally COMMITTED instance when receiving a COMMIT message with a higher ballot number for the same instance. This violates the safety property that a committed command's attributes (Seq, Deps) are immutable. In this scenario, a partitioned replica (R1) commits CmdA on the fast path. A recovery leader (R2), unaware of the commit, recovers CmdA with different attributes (depending on a conflicting CmdB) and a higher ballot. When the partition heals, R1 accepts the new attributes, leading to divergent execution orders (R1: A then B, R2: B then A).
trigger_condition: Network partition separating a fast-path committed replica from the recovery quorum, followed by recovery with a higher ballot.
test_template:
1. Setup 5 replicas.
2. R0 proposes CmdA, R1 commits it (Fast Path).
3. Partition R1.
4. R3 proposes conflicting CmdB, R2/R3/R4 commit it.
5. R2 recovers CmdA (higher ballot), forcing dependency on CmdB.
6. Heal partition. R2 sends new Commit(CmdA) to R1.
7. Check if R1 overwrites CmdA attributes.
8. Check for state divergence.
